verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The flavour pills are microscopic with unreadable text and run in reversed order. The subcopy and CTA sit off-axis over the peach circle. Still, A keeps the original's two-circle composition and the pills are consistent with each other. B has the same wrong brand placement and the same off-axis CTA. On top of that, it moves the peach circle onto the yellow one, which leaves the bottom-right empty. Its pills are inconsistent: CUCUMBER MINT is smaller, raised and nearly illegible, and the row starts left of the text column, so it looks more broken.
